title: Fermented Skincare Evolves Into Bio-Skincare as R828 Expands Globally
summary: The global skincare industry is undergoing a significant transformation. While ingredient origin and brand storytelling once played a central role in product marketing, consumers, retailers, and distributors are increasingly prioritizing scientific validation, efficacy data, and ingredient transpare

extraction.key_fact: 발효 스킨케어가 효능 검증 중심의 바이오 스킨케어로 바뀌는 가운데 R828이 해외 시장으로 확장하고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: One example is R828, a Korean skincare brand developed by Kairos Global, which is expanding into international markets with formulations built around fermented glutathione and naturally fermented plant-derived ingredients.
